$comment: Manifest of the Open Roll 5e family. sync.ps1 clones and fast-forwards the repos with "sync": true; a repo with "parent": true lives one folder ABOVE the suite (next to it, not inside it). tools/integration-map.mjs scans whatever is cloned inside. Keep this in step with GitHub: add a repo here when it is created, flip status when it is archived or retired. A public repo's "blurb" is the one-line description every README uses for it; tools/suite-sections.mjs writes those sections from here.

repos.name: fvtt-mod-autoexplore
repos.title: Open Roll 5e: Autoexplore
repos.description: Lets a scene start fully explored: the whole map shows through the fog of war while tokens still need line of sight, and no fog data is written.
repos.blurb: lets a scene start fully explored, so the whole map shows through the fog of war while tokens still need line of sight.

repos.name: fvtt-mod-battleflow
repos.title: Open Roll 5e: Battle Flow
repos.description: Combat automation for dnd5e 2024 rules: a hit rolls and applies its own damage, saves resolve themselves, reactions hold, concentration is tracked.
repos.note: fvtt-mod-battleflow-cover next to it is a git worktree of this repo on feat/cover-hover, not a separate clone; sync.ps1 leaves worktrees alone.
repos.blurb: combat automation for dnd5e 2024 rules: a hit rolls and applies its own damage, saves resolve themselves, reactions hold, and concentration is tracked. Every rule that touches a fight in the 2024 core books, Heroes of Faerûn, Arcana Unleashed and Ravenloft: The Horrors Within.

repos.name: fvtt-mod-combatplus
repos.title: Open Roll 5e: Combat Plus
repos.description: Automates the chores of running a fight: combat music, an initiative gate, an out-of-turn movement block, defeated marking at 0 HP, turn alerts.
repos.blurb: automates the chores of running a fight: combat music, an initiative gate, an out-of-turn movement block, defeated marking at 0 HP and turn alerts.

repos.name: fvtt-mod-errata5e
repos.title: Open Roll 5e: Errata
repos.description: Corrects, in memory, bugs in the premium D&D 2024 books, the dnd5e system and Foundry itself, each fix held until the vendor ships its own. Successor of fvtt-mod-vendorfixes.
repos.blurb: corrects, in memory, bugs in the premium D&D 2024 books, the dnd5e system and Foundry itself, each fix held until the vendor ships its own.

repos.name: fvtt-mod-fxstudio
repos.title: Open Roll 5e: FX Studio
repos.description: Visual and sound effects for dnd5e played from what actually happened at the table, through Sequencer with JB2A and PSFX; about a thousand stock FX and an authoring window.
repos.blurb: visual and sound effects for dnd5e, played from what actually happened at the table, with about a thousand stock FX and a window for authoring your own.

repos.name: fvtt-mod-lootshelf
repos.title: Open Roll 5e: Loot Shelf
repos.description: Loot chests and merchant shelves players can take from, buy from and sell to without owning them, with a chat receipt for every trade.
repos.blurb: loot chests and merchant shelves that players can take from, buy from and sell to without owning them, with a receipt for every trade.

repos.name: fvtt-mod-openserver
repos.title: Open Roll 5e: Open Server
repos.description: For hosted worlds: clears the startup pause so players can play before the GM arrives, and gives any user a landing scene of their own.
repos.blurb: for hosted worlds: clears the startup pause so players can play before the GM arrives, and gives any user a landing scene of their own.

repos.name: fvtt-mod-partystash
repos.title: Open Roll 5e: Party Stash
repos.description: Makes a dnd5e Group actor's inventory a working party stash: drags move instead of copy, coin moves through Deposit and Withdraw, stacks split, every transfer posts a receipt.
repos.blurb: makes a dnd5e Group actor's inventory a working party stash: drags move instead of copying, coin moves through a dialog, and every transfer posts a receipt.

repos.name: fvtt-mod-soundscape
repos.title: Open Roll 5e: Soundscape
repos.description: Background sound for scenes: random one-shots with silence between them, seamless crossfaded loops, day and night gating, quiet during combat.
repos.blurb: background sound for scenes: random one-shots with silence between them, seamless crossfaded loops, day and night gating, and quiet during combat.

repos.name: fvtt-mod-soundscape-sfx
repos.description: Private audio library for Soundscape (interval sound sets, ambient loop beds). Not a Foundry module.

repos.name: fvtt-mcp-dnd5e
repos.description: The DM-assistant MCP server. Drives any live Foundry world (Molten Hosting, a local install, a URL) through Claude Code. Formerly fvtt-mcp-molten5e. Writes Open Server's landing-scene flag and Soundscape's scene sound sets.
repos.blurb: builds D&D 5e content in a live Foundry world from Claude Code: a stat block becomes a complete NPC, a map image a walled and lit scene, an adventure its journals, tables and handouts.

repos.name: fvtt-mcp-imagegen
repos.description: Gemini image generation for Foundry art (icons, tokens, portraits, illustrations). MCP server key `artificer`. Formerly fvtt-app-artificer (renamed 2026-10-08) and before that fvtt-mcp-artificer.
repos.blurb: makes the art with Google's Gemini image models: icons, tokens, props, portraits and illustrations, token redresses and restyles, battlemap and overland-map repaints, and the illustrated session records, all grounded in what the world already shows.

repos.name: fvtt-mcp-sessionscribe
repos.description: Craig recording + Foundry chat log to session record (transcript, recap, combat report). MCP server key `scribe`; home of the session-scribe skill. Formerly fvtt-app-sessionscribe (renamed 2026-10-08).
repos.blurb: turns a session's Discord recording and Foundry chat log into its record. Its end-to-end `session-scribe` skill drives the server from the Craig link to a speaker-labelled transcript, a fully illustrated player recap, combat statistics, GM notes and a party snapshot.

repos.name: fvtt-campaign-echoesofhalruaa
repos.description: The current campaign (working title Echoes of Halruaa; scaffolded 2026-09-27 as fvtt-campaign-next). Lives ABOVE the suite, next to it: content, not code, with its own committing sync.ps1 on session hooks. This repo's sync only fast-forwards it.

repos.name: fvtt-mod-miscpatches
repos.title: Misc Patches
repos.description: Retired 2026-09-25. The GitHub repo no longer resolves (deleted after archiving) and no clone is kept (the last one was deleted 2026-10-08).

repos.name: fvtt-mod-vendorfixes
repos.description: Replaced by fvtt-mod-errata5e. GitHub repo archived; not cloned here.
